verdict.rationale: Anrok's AI Atlas lets users ask anything about their sales tax and get answers with the reasoning shown, grounded in their own transactions, registrations, filings and certificates. That is in-product AI insight generated from the user's own data, which is the core of the story. The evidence is a single marketing-page line with no hands-on detail. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations (beyond answering questions), in-depth documentation of AI Atlas, independent or hands-on corroboration.
